messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Interlingua, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Interlingua line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
O honor e luce del altere poetas, concede me le longe studio e le grande amor que me ha facite cercar tu volume.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | O | vocative particle addressing abstract entities | O | O | OK | | de | preposition indicating possession/association (“of”) | del | of the | OK | | li | definite article, masculine plural (“the”) | del | of the | OK | | altri | adjective meaning “other” | altere | other | OK | | poeti | noun “poets” | poetas | poets | OK | | onore | abstract quality “honor” | honor | honor | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | e | and | OK | | lume, | abstract quality “light” | luce | light | OK | | vagliami | imperative “let … be useful to me” (request) | concede | grant | OK | | 'l | definite article, masculine singular (“the”) | le | the | OK | | lungo | adjective “long” | longe | long | OK | | studio | noun “study” | studio | study | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | e | and | OK | | 'l | definite article, masculine singular (“the”) | le | the | OK | | grande | adjective “great” | grande | great | OK | | amore | noun “love” | amor | love | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which” | que | which | OK | | m'ha | enclitic “mi ha” – “has made me” | me ha | has made me | OK | | fatto | past participle “made” | facite | made | OK | | cercar | infinitive “to search” | cercar | search | OK | | lo | definite article “the” (article not required in Interlingua) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | tuo | possessive adjective “your” | tu | your | OK | | volume. | noun “volume” (book/poem) | volume. | volume | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY:** *lo* – the Italian definite article is omitted in Interlingua because the language does not require an article before a possessive noun. All other mappings are satisfactory.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Interlingua script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Interlingua text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: O honor e luce del altere poetas, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 2: - Original: concede me le longe studio e le grande amor - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 3: - Original: que me ha facite cercar tu volume. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
